scopes.title: Author observation and inference-product lineage
scopes.checked_claim: Selected Suyu locators distinguish radio delays relative to image B, ACS GO10158 F606W/F814W reconstruction and Keck1/LRIS aperture-dispersion fitting. Eq27 assumes independent individual delay PDFs; Eq32 explicitly approximates the fitted dispersion likelihood as Gaussian. The original delay source uses smoothed-composite Monte Carlo inputs with assumed Gaussian perturbations but reports non-Gaussian recovered delay distributions and68%/95% intervals. ACS slope is an imaging-conditioned posterior reused as a prior, including radio/NICMOS/delay optimization and stated delay-likelihood subtraction. M5 PSF-B1/three-band-dust substitution and regularization are author approximations. The count source uses four F814W exposures and Vega/AUTO selection. The OBS prior selects simulated overdense sightlines and differs from MS primary-lens-plane-excluded strong-lens selection.
scopes.unresolved: Radio time series, visibility/calibration and joint delay covariance; Keck spectra, complete slit/seeing geometry, templates/weights and spectral covariance; author PSF, dust, lens light, image covariance, masks and reconstruction products; catalogue/simulation identities and shared calibration/selection covariance remain unverified. Source factorization and fitted Gaussian priors are not measured native laws. Current archival processing does not establish the author2010 reduction or full likelihood.

limitations: Suyu reports AB31.5(+2.0,−1.0), CB36.0(±1.5), DB77.0(+2.0,−1.0) days relative to image B. Fassnacht v1 Table5 instead labels BA/BC/BD, with inputs31.5/36.0/77.0d and68% intervals30.5–33.5/34.5–37.5/76–79d (95%29–34.5/33.5–38.5/74–81d). Preserve both label orders and the literal t_j−tau shift; signed-symbol translation is unqualified. Monte Carlo smoothing/noise assumptions, residual-map RMS and0.6% calibration error condition the intervals. Recovered delay distributions are explicitly non-Gaussian; source independence does not establish empirical joint covariance.

Keck1/LRIS red observations on12June2007 use831/8200 with D680, nominal0.9arcsec seeing and18600s total exposure. A0.84arcsec/four-spatial-pixel G1 extraction, common0.915Angstrom grid, clipping and variance-weighted coaddition condition the spectrum. The selected source does not give a complete two-dimensional slit aperture or measured resampling/extraction covariance.

Nine INDO-US templates, nonnegative mixture coefficients, rest-frame4200–4900Angstrom fitting and continuum choices condition sigma260±15km/s. Its adopted error incorporates template mismatch/spread and statistical uncertainty; it is not a raw-detector or stellar-state distribution. Previous247±35km/s uses a different aperture.

Imaging models include PSF B, image covariance C_D, lens light l and dust K. F814W source/potential reconstruction, quadratic regularization, representative-model prior weights and M5 substitution are approximations. Actual author products, masks and model support remain unverified.

ACS gamma'2.08 with Gaussian standard deviation0.03 is a fitted imaging-conditioned prior. Thin degeneracy-tube optimization, equal G1/G2 slopes, radio/NICMOS data and delay-log-likelihood subtraction are retained conditions; complete marginalization or removal of all dependencies is unqualified. Table1's mean/scatter across three inferred H0 values omits delay uncertainty and is not a measured joint H0 error.

Fassnacht v1 environment counts use the first four GO10158 F814W exposures (2528s), distinct from its quoted28144s deep total and Suyu's full reconstruction. Vega/AUTO magnitudes, star/artifact cuts, cosmic-ray masks and lens-centred versus control-grid apertures define the sample. Raw catalogues, weights, detection completeness and reduction equivalence are unverified.

Suyu's OBS prior uses18.5≤m_F814W<24.5 within45arcsec and simulated selection1.95≤n/<n><2.05. Unlike the MS strong-lens subset, OBS neither subtracts a primary lens plane nor requires strong lensing. Approximate m_F814W=0.5m_i+0.5m_z, galaxy modelling, cosmology and high-convergence/local-environment treatment condition the prior; counts are not measured convergence.

Source variants remain unresolved: Suyu's2024 draft line versus2010 v2 watermark; Fassnacht abstract259 COSMOS fields versus body257 images; Fig1 caption68%/90% versus adjacent prose68%/95%. No replacement count or interval is inferred.

Spherical dynamics, stellar profiles, aperture/seeing convolution, radial-anisotropy prior and fixed-radius/redshift approximations remain author inputs. Pixel, delay, kinematic, calibration, catalogue, simulation and cross-probe covariance/distributions remain unknown.
